topPicks.editorialNote:
**Editorial Note:**

This tunnelling milestone directly impacts our neighbourhood's transport future—better connections mean easier commutes for the 19,850+ new residents expected here. We should clarify: which existing rail lines connect? When's completion? Also verify job accessibility claims. Readers aged 20–39 will want to know: how does this affect commute times to central London and local employment hubs?
